# A function is overridden the way a component is: the declaration names the
# target it implements, and inherits the signature of what it overrides.

# On the named target the override is the body; everywhere else the
# declaration's own body is. The call folds either way -- what changes is which
# body it folds.
sngl generate --platform html --lang none -o out_html app.sngl
grep 'web n=3' out_html/index.html
! grep 'tui n=3' out_html/index.html

sngl generate --platform bubbletea --lang go -o out_bt app.sngl
grep 'tui n=3' out_bt/model.go
! grep 'web n=3' out_bt/model.go

# A method has a name like anything else, so it is overridden like anything
# else -- the receiver is part of the name, not a different mechanism.
sngl generate --platform html --lang none -o out_m method.sngl
grep 'web 3' out_m/index.html
! grep 'tui 3' out_m/index.html

# The signature belongs to the declaration being overridden. Restating either
# half is declaring a different function, not implementing this one.
! sngl check params.sngl
stderr 'may not declare params'

! sngl check rettype.sngl
stderr 'may not declare a return type'

# Two implementations of one function for one target are two answers to a
# question with one.
! sngl check duplicate.sngl
stderr 'already has an implementation for "html"'

# An override implements something. There is nothing here to implement.
! sngl check unknown.sngl
stderr 'override names unknown function "nope"'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:app"
import "sngl:platform/html"

func label(n int) string {
    return "tui n=" + string(n)
}

func label[html.platform] {
    return "web n=" + string(n)
}

component main {
    window #w(title="t") {
        text(value=label(3))
    }
}

-- method.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:app"
import "sngl:platform/html"

func int.describe(n int) string {
    return "tui " + string(n)
}

func int.describe[html.platform] {
    return "web " + string(n)
}

component main {
    window #w(title="t") {
        text(value=int.describe(3))
    }
}

-- params.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:app"
import "sngl:platform/html"

func label(n int) string { return "base" }

func label[html.platform](n int) { return "x" }

component main {
    window #w(title="t") {
        text(value=label(1))
    }
}

-- rettype.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:app"
import "sngl:platform/html"

func label(n int) string { return "base" }

func label[html.platform] string { return "x" }

component main {
    window #w(title="t") {
        text(value=label(1))
    }
}

-- duplicate.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:app"
import "sngl:platform/html"

func label(n int) string { return "base" }

func label[html.platform] { return "a" }

func label[html.platform] { return "b" }

component main {
    window #w(title="t") {
        text(value=label(1))
    }
}

-- unknown.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:app"
import "sngl:platform/html"

func nope[html.platform] { return "x" }

component main {
    window #w(title="t") {
        text(value="hi")
    }
}
